$comment: Controlled theme vocabulary v2 (2026-08-21). Tagging rejects anything off-list; additions are schema changes. v2 changes from the 10-book review: sales_process retired (25% catch-all) and split into the 'process' group; 'onboarding' split into rep_onboarding (hiring) and customer_onboarding (marketing_gtm); marketing_gtm block added; unused 'discounting' dropped (concession_strategy covers it).

$glosses.cold_calling: initiating contact with prospects by phone
$glosses.email_outreach: prospecting via written outreach (email, social messages)
$glosses.social_selling: using social platforms to source and warm prospects
$glosses.questioning_technique: how to ask and sequence sales questions
$glosses.buyer_psychology: how buyers think, feel, and decide (including buyer indecision science)
$glosses.needs_analysis: uncovering and diagnosing customer needs and problems
$glosses.budget_authority: qualifying money, authority, and decision power
$glosses.rejection_resilience: coping with rejection and call reluctance
$glosses.indecision: buyer inaction, stalling, and fear of change
$glosses.pricing_defense: defending price and value under pressure
$glosses.commitment_gaining: asking for and securing buyer commitments
$glosses.urgency_creation: creating legitimate reasons to act now
$glosses.sales_methodology: named selling frameworks and structured approaches (SPIN, Challenger, gap analysis)
$glosses.funnel_design: designing funnels, conversion stages, and self-service/PLG motions
$glosses.process_management: defining and managing selling process as a manager
$glosses.forecasting: predicting revenue; forecast accuracy and cadence
$glosses.pipeline_inspection: reviewing pipeline health, coverage, and hygiene
$glosses.territory_planning: dividing and planning markets, territories, accounts
$glosses.coaching: developing skills through observation, practice, and feedback
$glosses.one_on_ones: structure and cadence of manager-report meetings
$glosses.performance_feedback: delivering praise and correction on performance
$glosses.difficult_conversations: high-stakes or emotionally charged workplace conversations
$glosses.scorecard_definition: defining role outcomes and competencies before hiring
$glosses.rep_onboarding: ramping newly hired employees to productivity
$glosses.activity_metrics: measuring and managing sales activities and inputs
$glosses.positioning: PRODUCT/MARKET positioning only — framing an offering against alternatives; never personal, conversational, or negotiation positioning
$glosses.pricing_strategy: how offerings are priced, packaged, and tiered
$glosses.growth_loops: viral, referral, and product-driven growth mechanisms
$glosses.customer_onboarding: getting users to first value in a product
$glosses.brand_messaging: crafting messages, stories, and content that stick
$glosses.team_culture: shared values, norms, and environment of a team
$glosses.decision_making: how leaders and organizations decide (buyer decisions belong to buyer_psychology)
$glosses.mindset: beliefs, drive, and mental frames for performance
